data.name: Faraasha
data.gender_notes: Faraasha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Faras', meaning horse, and 'Asha', meaning sincere. Faraasha is a beautiful name that signifies a gentle, fragrant, and sincere woman. The name Faraasha carries the meaning “Gentle, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faraasha usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes grace, elegance, and a connection to nature.
data.etymology: Faraasha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Fragrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faraasha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فراشة
in_arabic.meaning: الفراشة تعني الرفرفة أو الحركة الخفيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الفراشة مشتق من الفعل 'فرش' الذي يعني الانتشار أو التوسع. في اللغة العربية، الفراشة هي الحشرة التي ترفرف بأجنحتها وتتحرك بسهولة وحركة خفيفة. الاسم يحمل دلالة على الحركة والنشاط والحيوية. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن الفراشة ترمز إلى الهداية والرشاد.

in_urdu.name: فراشہ
in_urdu.meaning: فراشہ کا مطلب ہے ہلکی پھلکی حرکت یا اڑنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فراشہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'فرش' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پھیلانا یا وسیع کرنا۔ اردو میں، فراشہ ایک ایسے شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو ہلکا پھلکا اور آزاد ہو، جیسے کہ ایک تتلی جو اپنے پروں کو پھیلا کر اڑتی ہے۔ یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خلوص نیت، شفافیت، اور روحانی آزادی کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फराशा
in_hindi.meaning: फराशा का अर्थ है हल्की गति या उड़ना
in_hindi.long_meaning: फराशा नाम की उत्पत्ति 'फरश' शब्द से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है विस्तारित करना या फैलाना। हिंदी में, फराशा एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो हल्का और आजाद हो, जैसे कि एक तितली जो अपने पंखों को फैलाकर उड़ती है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सादगी, पवित्रता और आध्यात्मिक मुक्ति के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فراشه
in_pashto.meaning: فراشه د لږې خوځښتې يا الوتنې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فراشه نوم د عربي کلمې 'فرش' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده پراخه کول يا پر ستړیا. په پښتو کې، فراشه داسې چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې لږه او آزاده وي، لکه د یوې تیتلی چې خپل پرښې پراخوي او الوتنه کوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د سادگي، پاكۍ، او روحاني آزادۍ د نښې په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Faraasha
in_english.meaning: Faraasha means lightness, freedom, or gentle movement
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faraasha originates from the Arabic root 'فرش' (farsh), which means to spread or expand. In Islamic tradition, Faraasha symbolizes lightness, freedom, and spiritual liberation. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as purity, innocence, and agility. Faraasha is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person who embodies these qualities, reflecting the values of Islamic spirituality and tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Faraasha has a rich cultural significance rooted in the history and traditions of the Islamic world. Horses were, and continue to be, an integral part of Islamic culture, symbolizing power, strength, and freedom. Faraasha's name carries on this equine legacy, evoking images of beauty, grace, and agility. Moreover, this name is a reminder of the important role women have played in Islamic societies, being sinces and companions for their families, much like the reliability and unwavering loyalty of a horse.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Faraasha lies in its meaning - 'sincere'. In Islamic teachings, sincerity or 'ikhlas' is a crucial aspect of faith and worship. The name Faraasha is a constant reminder for the bearer to remain sincere in all her actions and intentions, striving for truth and purity in her thoughts, words, and deeds. It serves as a reminder to remain steadfast in her faith, to be true to herself and to her loved ones, and to seek Allah's pleasure above all else. Ultimately, Faraasha's name is a symbol of the inner qualities that all Muslims are encouraged to cultivate - kindness, compassion, truthfulness, and a strong connection to the Divine.
